lines.en: Why is the rescue taking so long?
lines.zh: 为什么救援用了这么长时间？

lines.en: Six men have been trapped in a mine for seventeen hours.
lines.zh: 六名男子被困在矿井里已经十七个小时了。

lines.en: If they are not brought to the surface soon they may lose their lives.
lines.zh: 如果他们不尽快被带到地面，他们可能会失去生命。

lines.en: However, rescue operations are proving difficult.
lines.zh: 然而，救援行动进展困难。

lines.en: If explosives are used, vibrations will cause the roof of the mine to collapse.
lines.zh: 如果使用炸药，震动将导致矿井顶部坍塌。

lines.en: Rescue workers are therefore drilling a hole on the north side of the mine.
lines.zh: 因此，救援人员正在矿井北侧钻一个洞。

lines.en: They intend to bring the men up in a special capsule.
lines.zh: 他们打算用一个特殊的胶囊将这些人带上来。

lines.en: If there had not been a hard layer of rock beneath the soil,
lines.zh: 如果土壤下面没有一层坚硬的岩石，

lines.en: they would have completed the job in a few hours.
lines.zh: 他们几个小时就能完成这项工作。

lines.en: As it is, they have been drilling for 16 hours and they still have a long way to go.
lines.zh: 事实上，他们已经钻了16个小时，还有很长的路要走。

lines.en: Meanwhile, a microphone, which was lowered into the mine two hours ago,
lines.zh: 同时，两个小时前被放入矿井的麦克风，

lines.en: has enabled the men to keep in touch with their closest relatives.
lines.zh: 使这些男子能够与他们最亲近的亲属保持联系。

lines.en: Though they are running out of food and drink,
lines.zh: 尽管他们的食物和饮用水即将耗尽，

lines.en: the men are cheerful and confident that they will get out soon.
lines.zh: 这些男子仍然很乐观，并相信他们很快就能出来。

lines.en: They have been told that rescue operations are progressing smoothly.
lines.zh: 他们被告知救援行动进展顺利。

lines.en: If they knew how difficult it was to drill through the hard rock, they would lose heart.
lines.zh: 如果他们知道钻穿坚硬的岩石有多困难，他们就会灰心丧气。
